title.narrative: Occupational safety and health of workers are improved, and a culture of prevention is developed in Viet Nam

description.narrative:
a) Occupational safety and health (OSH). ILO cooperates with constituents to raise awareness of occupational safety and health (OSH) improvement measures and to develop the capacity of national partners as well as to support the review and revisions of Viet Nam national OSH policies. Good OSH practices from ILO/IFC and Tripartite Partners Better Work Programme on garment/footwear, as well as from electronic and coffee industries, are being advocated for scaling up in the country.
b) Wage policy Along with the process of transforming the economy, the Government of Viet Nam and Social Partners have made progress to improve wage policies and practices in recent years. To promote efficiency and wage growth, ILO supports constituents on: (i) strengthening dialogue and negotiation mechanisms to set wages according to market mechanisms, improving bargaining and agreement capacity about salary; continue to effectively implement the minimum wage policy and strengthening the inforamtion/data system as a basis for planning minimum wage policies and negotiating wages;
